title: Your Tteokbokki Order
blurb: Spice, toppings, steam, the pot, the fried rice. How long can you actually wait.

questions.q: Time to pick a spice level.
questions.a: Level 1. My tongue has plans tomorrow.
questions.b: The hottest one. I'm not reading the rest of this menu.

questions.q: Toppings. Cheese, fish cake, or ramyeon noodles.
questions.a: I name each one and decide what melts first.
questions.b: All of it. The chopsticks can sort it out.

questions.q: The pot shows up, still screaming hot.
questions.a: I fan it with chopsticks and actually wait.
questions.b: One blow and it's in. My tongue can complain later.

questions.q: Plate, or straight from the pot?
questions.a: Plate. I came here for the cheese pull.
questions.b: Face in the pot. Plates are for people with time.

questions.q: Sauce left. Fried rice in the same pan?
questions.a: Rice in, medium heat, every grain gets a coat.
questions.b: The rice hits the pan and the spoon is already going.

results.title: Steam Respecter
results.summary: Spice, toppings, rice, all in order. You let it cool. Your friends are done. You're still on bite one.
results.comment: Nobody else is waiting with you.

results.title: One Reckless Bite
results.summary: You wait for almost everything. Then one moment the chopsticks just go, and that bite wins.
results.comment: That one bite is the whole result.

results.title: Medium Panic
results.summary: You do let it cool. A little. The cheese hasn't even stretched and you're already in there.
results.comment: Your patience lasts about as long as a fish cake stays firm.

results.title: Pot First
results.summary: Choosing took longer than eating. You're gonna feel this tomorrow.
results.comment: The fried rice wasn't a plan. Your hand just did it.

results.title: Full Send
results.summary: Hottest level, every topping, the pot, the fried rice. You skipped the waiting every time.
results.comment: Let it cool is not a sentence you hear.
